scripts.title: V30
scripts.script:
-- سكربت Delta Yazan V30 للموبايل فقط
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local UIGridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

ScreenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "DeltaYazanV30"

Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 400)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -200)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)

UIGridLayout.Parent = Frame
UIGridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 30)
UIGridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)

local function createBtn(name, func)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = Frame
    btn.Text = name
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 0)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(func)
end

-- أزرار الميزات
createBtn("طيران", function()
    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
    wait(3)
    bv:Destroy()
end)

createBtn("نسخ السكن", function()
    local clone = char:Clone()
    clone.Parent = workspace
    clone:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(5,0,0))
end)

createBtn("تخريب البيوت", function()
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Part") and obj.Name == "Door" then obj:Destroy() end
    end
end)

createBtn("مؤثرات بصرية", function()
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire", hrp)
    fire.Size = 10
    fire.Heat = 5
end)

createBtn("مؤثرات صوتية", function()
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound", hrp)
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://138186576"
    sound:Play()
end)

createBtn("إخفاء الواجهة", function()
    Frame.Visible = false
end)

createBtn("إظهار الواجهة", function()
    Frame.Visible = true
end)

createBtn("رسالة ترحيب", function()
    local msg = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
    msg.Text = "أهلاً بك في سكربت يزن 🔥"
    wait(3)
    msg:Destroy()
end)

createBtn("تسريع", function()
    char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = 50
end)

createBtn("قفزة عالية", function()
    char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").JumpPower = 100
end)

createBtn("لون الشخصية", function()
    for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255) end
    end
end)

createBtn("نمط أنمي", function()
    local spark = Instance.new("Sparkles", hrp)
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound", hrp)
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1843529630"
    sound:Play()
end)

createBtn("رقص", function()
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://148840371"
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    hum:LoadAnimation(anim):Play()
end)

createBtn("خروج", function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
